title: 第4章  为师已经替你试过了
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
叶长天闭目消化了一下脑海中的信息。
片刻后。
他那一双紧闭的眼眸乍然睁开。
这阴阳造化诀不仅是一门举世无双的双修传承，而且本身也是一件无上至宝！
它里面有着一个阴阳造化界，不仅可能用来储物，而且只要吸收足够的灵力，就能产生一种夺天地造化的阴阳之力。
这阴阳之力不仅能够助人修行，更是有着修复万物的能力。
它可以将残缺的功法宝物补全，也可以让残次品的丹药变成最完美的极品神丹！
这便是所谓的夺天地阴阳，享无上造化！
“好逆天的阴阳造化界！”
叶长天心头一片火热。
有了阴阳造化诀以及阴阳造化界，哪怕他这个伪灵根的废物，也定能在这个修行世界闯出一片天地来！
叶长天深吸一口气，目光望向了柳嫣然还给他的灵石与玄灵宝珠。
他意念一动，灵石与玄灵宝珠就直接凭空出现在了阴阳造化界。
下一秒。
一万灵石就以肉眼可见的速度迅速在阴阳造化界内消失得无影无踪。
而阴阳造化界内，也是凭空出现了一缕黑白相间的神秘能量。
“这就是阴阳造化界中诞生的阴阳之力么？”
叶长天惊奇不已。
他意念一动，操控着那一缕阴阳之力，将其注入了玄灵宝珠内。
玄灵宝珠顿时爆发出了一阵璀璨的光华。

叶长天敏锐地发现，玄灵宝珠原本约么拇指大小的缺口，竟然神奇般地小了一圈！
刚才那一缕阴阳之力，似乎真的修复了玄灵宝珠！
叶长天连忙拿出玄灵宝珠感受了一下。
如果说以前的玄灵宝珠可以让佩戴者的修炼速度提升两三倍，现在恐怕至少能提升五倍左右。
而且这还是没有完全修复的情况下。
若是玄灵宝珠完全修复，叶长天都无法想象效果会是何等的逆天！
“看来得想办法多搞一些灵石了。”
叶长天神情激动。
只要拥有足够的灵石，让阴阳造化界不断诞生阴阳之力，哪怕他这个伪灵根的废物，也不是没有问道长生的可能！
“先去晋升为外门弟子吧。”
叶长天微微沉吟了片刻，很快就做出了决定。
杂役弟子在太玄宗地位低下，几乎享受不了太玄宗的任何宗门福利。
一旦成为正式弟子，哪怕只是外门弟子，每个月都能领取一定的灵石以及修炼资源。
不仅如此。
外门弟子还能领取宗门任务，赚取灵石与修炼资源。
以叶长天如今炼气四层巅峰的修为，成为外门弟子完全绰绰有余。
叶长天没有犹豫，简单的收拾了一番就大步离开了房间。
太玄宗，太玄宫。
这里乃是太玄宗最具有标志性的建筑之一，只有太玄宗历代掌门方才有资格居住于此。
夏秋水回到太玄宫后，第一时间就要准备闭关冲击化神境。

可就在这时。
夏秋水似乎突然想到了什么，身形一闪就出现在了太玄宫的后花园中。
在夏秋水面前，赫然有着一位白裙飘飘的绝美女子正专心致志地为花园中的灵药浇水。
她气质出尘，宛如从九天之上而来的仙女一般，不染尘俗。
“见过师尊。”
看到突然出现的夏秋水，白裙女子先是愣了一愣，旋即连忙对着夏秋水行了一礼。
“青霜，你乃万中无一的天品灵根，当初要不是为师大意，你也不会根基被毁，修为尽失。”
夏秋水一脸歉意地看着月青霜，更多的是心疼。
在玄黄大世界，修行灵根天赋分为下品，中品，高品，极品，天品，仙品。
月青霜，太玄宗当世唯一拥有天灵根的绝世天才，不到二十岁就修炼至金丹境，也是太玄宗曾经当之无愧的圣女。
这等天之娇女，却因为一次意外根基被毁，修为尽失。
如今只能在太玄宫内，与这些花花草草相伴。
夏秋水这段时间尝试了各种让月青霜恢复的办法，结果都失败了。
不过——
昨天晚上发生的事情，无疑是让夏秋水看到了让月青霜恢复的希望。
月青霜轻笑一声道：“师尊不用自责，这都是命，而且青霜觉得在这里与这些花花草草相伴，其实也挺好的。”
“以你的天赋，未来突破元婴化神都是轻而易举的事情，不应该一辈子被困在这里。”
夏秋水摇了摇头，直接开门见山地道：“青霜，我准备闭关冲击化神境，太玄宗有一位名叫叶长天的杂役弟子，你去找他吧，他能让你重回巅峰的。”
“师尊，您……您没开玩笑吧？”
月青霜抬头望着夏秋水，绝美的脸庞上也是浮现出了一抹愕然的神色。

她身上的问题，连师尊这个太玄宗宗主、元婴巅峰境强者都解决不了，一个杂役弟子怎么可能解决？
“你觉得为师像是在开玩笑？”
“我可以确定地告诉你，他能让你恢复过来，不要问我为什么，你自己去找他就行了。”
夏秋水一脸笃定地道。
叶长天能不能让你恢复，为师难道还不清楚么？
因为为师已经替你试过了！
不过——
她就这么把月青霜送到叶长天的身边去，岂不是意味着她们师徒以后要一起……
啊……呸！
夏秋水连忙甩开脑海中那些乱七八糟的想法。
她在想什么呢？
她可是堂堂太玄宗掌门，心中只有自己的长生大道，昨晚与叶长天完全就是一个意外，绝对不可能再有下一次的！
嗯……这辈子都不可能！
“师尊，我去找到叶长天后，究竟要怎么做？”
见得夏秋水并不是在开玩笑，月青霜不由一脸好奇地问道。
虽然她实在想不明白一名杂役弟子如何让她重回巅峰，可师尊既然这样说那就有她的理由。
既然如此，月青霜无论如何也要试一试。
身为拥有天品灵根的绝世天才。
如果可以，月青霜又怎么甘心就这么虚度一生呢？
夏秋水身形一闪，直接凭空消失在了月青霜的面前，只留下一道淡淡的声音在月青霜耳边不断回荡。

“简单，你去跟他睡觉就行。”
“睡一觉不行，那就多睡两觉，睡到你恢复过来为止！”
content_en:
Ye Changtian closed his eyes and digested the information in his mind.
After a while.
His closed eyes suddenly opened.
This Yin and Yang Creation Technique is not only a unique inheritance of dual cultivation, but it is also a supreme treasure in itself!
There is a yin and yang realm of creation inside it. Not only can it be used to store goods, but as long as it absorbs enough spiritual power, it can produce a yin and yang power that dominates the creation of heaven and earth.
This power of yin and yang can not only help people practice, but also has the ability to repair all things.
It can complete the incomplete skills and treasures, and it can also turn the defective elixirs into the most perfect and top-grade magical elixirs!
This is the so-called yin and yang that seizes the world and enjoys supreme creation!
"What a heaven-defying world of yin and yang creation!"
Ye Changtian's heart was burning.
With the Yin-Yang Creation Technique and the Yin-Yang Creation Realm, even a waste like him with pseudo-spiritual roots will definitely be able to make a name for himself in this world of cultivation!
Ye Changtian took a deep breath and looked at the spirit stones and Xuanling Orbs that Liu Yanran returned to him.
With a thought, the spirit stones and mysterious orbs appeared directly out of thin air in the Yin and Yang world of creation.
The next second.
Ten thousand spirit stones quickly disappeared without a trace in the world of Yin and Yang creation at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In the world of Yin and Yang creation, a wisp of black and white mysterious energy also appeared out of thin air.
"Is this the power of yin and yang born in the world of yin and yang creation?"
Ye Changtian was amazed.
With a thought, he controlled the ray of yin and yang power and injected it into the Xuanling Orb.
The Xuanling Orb suddenly burst out with a burst of bright brilliance.
Ye Changtian keenly discovered that the gap in the Xuanling Orb, which was originally about the size of a thumb, miraculously shrank in size!
That ray of yin and yang power just now seems to have really repaired the Xuanling Orb!
Ye Changtian quickly took out the Xuanling Orb and felt it.
If the Xuanling Orb in the past could increase the wearer's cultivation speed by two or three times, now I am afraid it can increase it by at least five times.
And this is still not completely repaired.
If the Xuanling Orb is completely repaired, Ye Changtian can't imagine how incredible the effect will be!
"It seems we have to find a way to get more spiritual stones."
Ye Changtian looked excited.
As long as he has enough spiritual stones to continuously generate the power of yin and yang in the yin and yang world of creation, even a waste with pseudo-spiritual roots like him has the possibility of immortality!
"Let's go and be promoted to an outer disciple first."
Ye Changtian pondered for a moment and quickly made a decision.
The handyman disciples have a low status in Taixuan Sect and can hardly enjoy any sect benefits of Taixuan Sect.
Once you become a formal disciple, even if you are just an outer disciple, you can receive a certain amount of spiritual stones and cultivation resources every month.
Not only that.
Outer disciples can also receive sect tasks and earn spiritual stones and cultivation resources.
With Ye Changtian's current cultivation level at the peak of the fourth level of Qi refining, it is more than enough to become an outer disciple.
Ye Changtian did not hesitate, simply cleaned up and left the room in large strides.
Taixuanzong, Taixuan Palace.
This is one of the most iconic buildings of Taixuanzong, and only the successive heads of Taixuanzong are qualified to live here.
After Xia Qiushui returned to Taixuan Palace, he immediately prepared to retreat and attack the realm of transformation.
But at this moment.
Xia Qiushui seemed to suddenly think of something, and appeared in the back garden of Taixuan Palace in a flash.
In front of Xia Qiushui, there was a beautiful woman in a white dress who was concentrating on watering the elixir in the garden.
Her temperament is pure and pure, like a fairy coming from the nine heavens, untainted by the worldly world.
"I've met Master."
Seeing the sudden appearance of Xia Qiushui, the woman in the white dress was stunned for a moment, then quickly saluted to Xia Qiushui.
"Qingshuang, you have a heavenly spiritual root that is unique among all. If you hadn't been careless as a teacher, your foundation would not have been destroyed and your cultivation would have been lost."
Xia Qiushui looked at Yue Qingshuang apologetically, feeling even more distressed.In the big world of Xuanhuang, the talent of cultivating spiritual roots is divided into low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade, top-grade, heaven-grade, and fairy-grade.
Yue Qingshuang, the only peerless genius in the world of Taixuanzong who possessed the Heavenly Spiritual Root, had reached the golden elixir realm before she was twenty years old. She was also a well-deserved saintess of Taixuanzong.
Such a beautiful girl from heaven, but because of an accident, her foundation was destroyed and her cultivation was completely lost.
Now I can only stay with these flowers and plants in Taixuan Palace.
Xia Qiushui tried various methods to restore Yue Qingshuang during this period, but they all failed.
But——
What happened last night undoubtedly gave Xia Qiushui hope of Yue Qingshuang's recovery.
Yue Qingshuang chuckled and said: "Master, there is no need to blame yourself, this is fate, and Qingshuang feels that it is actually quite good to be here with these flowers and plants."
"With your talent, it will be easy to break through the Nascent Soul and become a god in the future. You shouldn't be trapped here for the rest of your life."
Xia Qiushui shook his head and said straight to the point: "Qingshuang, I'm going to retreat to attack the realm of gods. Taixuan Sect has a handyman disciple named Ye Changtian. Go find him. He can help you return to the top."
"Master, you...are you kidding?"
Yue Qingshuang looked up at Xia Qiushui, and a look of astonishment appeared on her beautiful face.
Even her master, the master of the Taixuan Sect and a master at the peak level of Nascent Soul, couldn't solve her problems. How could a handyman disciple solve it?
"Do you think my teacher is joking?"
"I can tell you with certainty that he can make you recover. Don't ask me why, just go find him yourself."
Xia Qiushui said with determination.
Isn’t it clear to me whether Ye Changtian can make you recover?
Because my teacher has already tried it for you!
But——
She just sent Yue Qingshuang to Ye Changtian, doesn't it mean that their master and apprentice will be together in the future...
Ah... Bah!
Xia Qiushui quickly shook off the messy thoughts in her mind.
What was she thinking?
She is the head of Taixuan Sect, and she only has her own path to immortality in her heart. Last night with Ye Changtian was a complete accident, and there is absolutely no way it will happen again!
Well...it's impossible in this life!
"Master, if I go to find Queen Ye Changtian, what exactly should I do?"
Seeing that Xia Qiushui was not joking, Yue Qingshuang couldn't help but ask curiously.
Although she really couldn't understand how a handyman disciple could bring her back to the top, but since the master said so, she had a reason.
In this case, Yue Qingshuang would give it a try no matter what.
As a peerless genius with heavenly spiritual roots.
If possible, how could Yue Qingshuang be willing to waste her life like this?
Xia Qiushui's figure flashed and disappeared directly in front of Yue Qingshuang, leaving only a faint voice echoing in Yue Qingshuang's ears.
"It's easy, just go sleep with him."
"If one sleep is not enough, then sleep two more times until you recover!"
